actions.reason: The K8_C0006|K8_C0008 boundary is the weakest-supported decision-relevant pair: structural diagnostics show only moderate agreement with an independent two-way partition (ARI 0.506), a high normalized-cut cost (0.635) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and a union eigengap dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, 0.539 vs 0.262 at k=2), which is merge-compatible. Native-view separation is conflicting, expressed almost exclusively in WXS (0.400) with no separation in CT, RNA, or WSI. The two sets' RNA phenotypes are not mutually exclusive: K8_C0006 is metabolic-repressed with Wnt/mitotic activation and K8_C0008 is proliferative (G2M/E2F up) and immune-quiet, both sharing suppressed immune programs, so the union is consistent with a single proliferative/immune-quiet unit. This is a provisional comparative revision of the weakest boundary.

actions.reason: K8_C0001 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: strong PBRM1 enrichment (13/13) surviving driver-panel and global multiplicity correction with near-ubiquitous VHL (13/13) (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:76b61289b9). Membership representation is modality-discordant (WXS strongly positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:76b61289b9), but the decision-relevant neighboring boundaries are not merge-compatible: the K8_C0001/K8_C0004 boundary is weak-to-conflicting with CT showing essentially no separation (ER:...pair:ae82aab5c4), and the K8_C0001/K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 boundary is conflicting with three of four views zero or negative (ER:...pair:6867cb538a). No supported split or merge alternative exists, so the candidate is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity defined by marked VHL depletion (0/15 vs 56/88) surviving driver-panel and global multiplicity correction (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:6ae93549e8). No supported split or merge alternative exists, so the candidate is retained.
